Eva van Pelt

Independent consultant, former co-CEO of the Eppendorf Group

Personal information

Member of the Supervisory Board since: 2026, elected until 2029
 

Personal Information:  

Place of residence: Straßlach-Dingharting 

Year of birth: 1965 

Nationality: German 

Professional Qualification: Bachelor of Business Administration 

 

Committees

• Member of the Nomination Committee

 

Relevant knowledge, skills, and experience for serving on the Supervisory Board: 

Eva van Pelt is an independent consultant and served as Co-Chair of the Executive Board of the Eppendorf Group from 2019 to 2023, having previously served on the Executive Board as Chief Commercial Officer since 2017. Prior to that, she served as Vice President and General Manager EMEA at Leica Microsystems from 2015 to 2017 and as Executive Director of Healthcare and Life Sciences EMEA at Hitachi Data Systems from 2012 to 2015. From 2010 to 2012, she worked as Director of Healthcare at Accenture. Before that, she held various leadership positions at Siemens from 1996 to 2010, including Director of Health Services and Global Solutions and Senior Vice President of IC Mobile. From 1994 to 1996, she worked as an internal consultant at MPE Mannesmann Pilotentwicklung. Eva van Pelt has been President of the German-Dutch Chamber of Commerce since 2023.

 

Memberships on other legally required domestic Supervisory Boards: 

Paul Hartmann AG (publicly listed) 

 

Membership in comparable domestic or foreign supervisory bodies of commercial enterprises: 

QIAGEN N.V. (publicly listed) 

Ottobock Management SE (unlisted) 

 

Other substantial activities in addition to the Supervisory Board mandate:

German-Dutch Chamber of Commerce, President 

Independent Consultant
